title: C5 supervisor manifest
description: /tmp/tsb/supervisors/{supervisor_id}/manifest.json. Every live one names one member of the set of supervisors the core addresses (decision 5.13). A supervisor is live when its control_sock accepts a connection; missing or refused means dead, and the core skips it. pid is informational only — meaningful inside the writer's PID namespace (the supervisor is PID 1 of the worker container). Closed, like the worker manifest. proto_version is the C3 version this supervisor and its workers speak; absent, it is a v0.1 supervisor, and a v0.2 core creates no worker through it (supervisor.schema.json).

control_sock.description: Absolute path of the supervisor's control socket.

proto_version.description: C3 0.8 at this tag; absent means v0.1. Older manifests remain valid (C3/terminal-disposal-version-gate).
